title: Anthropic · 模型列表来源更新
summary: 新增模型能力描述，说明 thinking.types.between_tools 属性。

added_lines: Each model's capabilities object also includes thinking.types.between_tools, which reports whether the model accepts thinking: {type: "between_tools"}, the setting that turns off up-front thinking. supported is false when the model rejects "between_tools" with a 400 error. Even when supported is true, the API can still reject a "between_tools" request for another reason, such as an effort level that the model doesn't allow with "between_tools". For Claude Sonnet 5.5, for example, the Models API reports thinking.types.between_tools.supported as true and thinking.types.disabled.supported as false.
